notes:
Original source unavailable: terminal cache miss 21ae3ca30ea09cd7c1aecb17.miss. Original values reproduced by Song were not used. Requested effect type is test statistic, but the target coefficient rows print regression coefficients and Newey–West standard errors, not coefficient-specific t/z tests; retained the printed coefficient without conversion. The table J-test and its p value test instrument restrictions, so neither is substituted for the target coefficient test. Reported success is the author’s overall narrative verdict; no separate verdict for this covariate is printed. The neutral private-consumption description is matched to the lagged private-consumption coefficient Δc(i,t−1), the only private-consumption predictor row in the specified table. p is the printed *** significance threshold, not an exact p value.
Source follow-up: Fresh blind original-only extraction from the supplied published article. The unassigned replication and success fields are placeholders. The named coefficient is printed, but its coefficient-specific t/z statistic and exact p are not printed. Parentheses contain Newey–West standard errors, not test statistics. No coefficient/SE conversion was performed. The p value is a two-tailed significance threshold from the printed stars, recorded conservatively as <=, not an exact p. The 12 is the analytic number of country panels; it must not be interpreted as the regression observation count. The consumption variable named in the locator appears as the lagged consumption regressor, not as a joint model test.
